caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with a slightly flared rim and a rounded body. The jar is primarily gray with shading to indicate curvature and light, and displays some brownish areas, especially around the rim and base. The top rim area is unglazed and brownish in color, and the jar has visible cracks and subtle surface imperfections. Near the top, there is a decorative band comprised of alternating dark blue and light gray scalloped shapes with small dots and lines extending downward. On the center of the jar are the words "COMMERAW'S STONEWARE" written in blue capital letters. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a gray rectangular box with the text "N. YORK HOOK CORLEARS" written in blue capital letters. At the lower right margin of the drawing, the artist's name "FRANCIS BORELLI" is printed in capital letters. The drawing is on a light beige background and is bordered by a simple rectangular line frame.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
